mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in real personal savings signals a shift in consumer behavior towards spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer-driven sectors benefit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% & PAYEMS increases in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPIAUCSL) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPIAUCSL) coupled with an increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) signals deflationary pressure and consumer saving, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows and economic growth weakens.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases & RSAFS increases in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreases and RSAFS increases in the same month.
